description: Source code for managing application key files, including generating file paths, creating files, and checking for existing good key files within a directory.

classes.name: starboard::ScopedFile
classes.description: RAII wrapper for file descriptor management, used for safe file creation.

methods.name: GetAppKeyFilePathWithSuffix
methods.description: Constructs a file path for an app key with a specific suffix.

methods.name: GetGoodAppKeyFilePath
methods.description: Returns the file path for a 'good' app key file.

methods.name: GetBadAppKeyFilePath
methods.description: Returns the file path for a 'bad' app key file.

methods.name: CreateAppKeyFile
methods.description: Creates a new file at the specified path.

methods.name: AnyGoodAppKeyFile
methods.description: Checks if any 'good' app key file exists in the specified directory.
